Notes.Name: Switch Statement
Notes.Details: To check multiple conditions, use a Switch statement. The Switch statement is equivalent to a series of If statements, but it is simpler. The Switch statement lists each condition and an optional action. If a condition obtains, the action is performed.

Notes.Name: If/ElseIf/Else Statement
Notes.Details: You can use the If statement to run code blocks if a specified conditional test evaluates to true. Use ElseIf to evaluate different scenarios

Notes.Name: If/Else Statement
Notes.Details: You can use the If statement to run code blocks if a specified conditional test evaluates to true.
